source.variation: Appendix I Frame 7 numbers six movements: 1–3 form the left body and bar, 4–5 the inner upright and broad right bowl, and 6 the lower hook. Native writers draw them as one continuous stroke, and this ductus follows them in order without lifting. The bundled Noto Sans Tamil print face simplifies the source's looped left body and high bar into a retraced upright with a low crossbar that runs straight into the bowl's foot, so movement 3 carries on round the foot and up the bowl's right side, movement 4 comes back left over the top into the inner upright, and movement 5 descends it into the stem below the baseline.
